Basic Payloads
Simple List:
Just a list containing an entry in each line
Runtime File:
A list read in runtime (not loaded in memory). For supporting big lists.
Case Modification:
Apply some changes to a list of strings(No change, to lower, to UPPER, to Proper name - First capitalized and the rest to lower-, to Proper Name -First capitalized an the rest remains the same-.
Numbers:
Generate numbers from X to Y using Z step or randomly.
Brute Forcer:
Character set, min & max length.
